title: RSSB Computer Instructor Exam Date 2026
vacancyDetails: Exam schedule for Basic Computer Instructor (22 Aug) and Senior Computer Instructor (23 Aug) 2026
qualification: As per RSSB Computer Instructor / Anudeshak notification (degree + computer qualification)
ageLimit: 18 to 40 years as on 01 January 2027 (as reported in notices)
selectionProcess: CBT / Written papers (two papers, two shifts) → DV
documentsRequired: Application credentials for future admit card; photo ID on exam day
howToApply:
1. Visit https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in
2. Read Computer Instructor exam date notice
3. Note Basic: 22 Aug 2026 | Senior: 23 Aug 2026
4. Download admit card when released before exam
5. Appear in both shifts as applicable
shortDescription: RSSB Computer Instructor Exam Date 2026: Basic on 22 August, Senior on 23 August 2026 (two shifts each). Admit card before exam.
content:
RSSB has notified the revised exam schedule for Computer Instructor recruitment (Advt. 07/2026).

Schedule

  • Basic Computer Instructor: 22 August 2026 (Saturday) – 2 papers (10:00–12:00 & 15:00–17:00)
  • Senior Computer Instructor: 23 August 2026 (Sunday) – same shift pattern

Application period was 25 May – 23 June 2026. Admit cards will be issued before the exam on rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.
